name: jev-compact
description: Compacts by cutting tool output that can be re-read instead of summarizing the conversation; Jev decides what stays

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: shadow: compute and report what would be cut, but let the native compaction run. active: replace the native compaction.

provider.title: Jev provider
provider.description: Where Jev is called. openrouter reads OPENROUTER_API_KEY, typesafe reads TYPESAFE_API_KEY from the environment; without the key only the local rules run.

targetTokens.title: Target context (tokens)
targetTokens.description: Each stage only runs while the cut transcript is still above this size. The cut replaces the native summary when it reaches this size or saves the sufficient reduction; otherwise the native summary runs over the cut transcript.

sufficientReduction.title: Sufficient reduction
sufficientReduction.description: Share of the context a cut has to save to replace the native summary even when it misses the target, e.g. 0.4 for 40%.

keepThreshold.title: Keep threshold
keepThreshold.description: A tool output stays verbatim when Jev's keep probability reaches this value.

aggressiveThreshold.title: Aggressive keep threshold
aggressiveThreshold.description: Used when the normal threshold misses the target.

preserveRecentMessages.title: Protected recent messages
preserveRecentMessages.description: The newest messages, and the first one, are never cut.

previewChars.title: Preview for Jev (chars)
previewChars.description: How much of each tool output Jev sees, after secrets are redacted. 0 sends no output at all.

keepHeadChars.title: Head kept when cutting (chars)
keepHeadChars.description: How much of a cut tool output stays in the transcript.
